notes.subject: long Parao
notes.rationale: Olgeta ples i narim wantaim 'bilong yu' — tok i go stret long Parao

notes.subject: רשימה bilong ples
notes.rationale: Hibru i putim sevenpela ples klostu — graun bilong haus, rum, bed, haus wokman, man, paia-haus, bokis bret — namba seven olsem plaga

translation: Na wara bilong ples Ijip bai i kamap planti olsem ol wara-pikinini-kakaruk, na ol bai go antap na ol bai kam insait long haus bilong yu, na long rum bilong slip bilong yu, na antap long bed bilong yu, na long haus bilong ol wokman bilong yu, na long ol man bilong yu, na long ol paia-haus bilong yu, na long ol bokis bilong wokim bret bilong yu.

na long ol paia-haus bilong yu
